components.name: Primary Button (Studio)

narrative.northStar: Ink & Hazard — warm editorial ink meets Swiss hazard printing
narrative.overview: One site with two deliberately separate design languages, never merged. Studio is warm editorial ink: carbon and bone, serif display, single desaturated ink-blue accent, crisp radii, flat calm. Field is Swiss hazard printing: carbon and newsprint, massive uppercase Archivo Black, single hazard-red accent, zero radius, hard dividers. A visitor knows which room they're in instantly — that recognition is the system working.
keyCharacteristics: Two rooms, one archive — personas never share visual language
One accent per persona at a time: ink-blue or hazard-red, never both
Weight- and case-driven hierarchy; gradients are whispers (4–5% opacity max)
Tabular figures everywhere data appears; flat surfaces; borders over shadows
Craft lives in the details: captions, heading order, contrast — audited

rules.name: The Two Rooms Rule
rules.body: Studio and field never share accent language. An element that works in both rooms must earn it in each persona's tokens separately — no cross-persona homogenization, ever.

rules.name: The Whisper Rule
rules.body: Gradients are whispers, never banners: hero glow lands at 4–5% opacity. Nothing larger than a hint.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Each persona carries exactly one accent hue at a time. If a second accent color appears in a persona, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Case Boundary Rule
rules.body: Field shouts in uppercase; studio keeps sentence case. A studio headline in all-caps is a persona leak.

rules.name: The Measured Macro Rule
rules.body: Field's giant type is sized from measurement (PHOTOGRAPHY ≈ 8.1em wide in Archivo Black), never guesswork — no mid-word breaks, no right-edge clipping, ever.

dos: Do scope every accent decision through the active persona's tokens (--accent-start/-end/-text) — never hardcode a persona's hex outside its layer.
Do keep accent-colored text AA-safe: light theme uses the deepened per-persona --accent-text.
Do use tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) for any data, both personas.
Do keep functional micro-text at or above 0.75rem (12px).
Do verify heading order (no skipped levels) in authored content.
donts: Don't merge, blend, or cross-pollinate the studio and field visual languages — the Two Rooms Rule is binding (PRODUCT.md).
Don't let a gradient exceed a whisper — hero glow caps at 4–5% opacity; a gradient banner or gradient text is a violation.
Don't introduce a second accent hue into either persona.
Don't stack or darken shadows beyond the studio 1px lift; field gets none.
Don't fabricate content, testimonials, or metrics — the archive is real or it doesn't ship.
